attempted_claim: Let N=(CP^1×CP^2)#CP^3, let α, β, γ be the standard generators of H^2(N;Z), and let M_{m,n,l} be the total space of the principal S^1-bundle over N with Euler class mα+nβ+lγ. For primitive triples gcd(m,n,l)=1, determine necessary and sufficient arithmetic conditions on two triples (m,n,l) and (m',n',l') for the simply connected closed 7-manifolds M_{m,n,l} and M_{m',n',l'} to be orientation-preservingly diffeomorphic, including the non-spin cases.
decisive_failure: Necessary Gysin/Smith and spin invariants were computed and shown insufficient via explicit collisions; the sufficient Kreck-Stolz plus surgery direction, especially for non-spin cases, was scoped but not executed, so no sufficient arithmetic diffeomorphism criterion is claimed.
